title: Generic freeness for finitely presented algebra-module pairs
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative integral domain and $A$ a commutative $R$-algebra admitting a presentation $A\cong R[x_1,\ldots,x_n]/(g_1,\ldots,g_m)$ for finite $n,m\geq0$. Let $L$ be a finitely presented $A$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. There is $0\ne a\in R$ such that $L_a$ is a free $R_a$-module, where $R_a=R[1/a]$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away] and $L_a$ is the module of fractions $\ell/a^j$ with equality $\ell/a^j=\ell'/a^k$ if and only if some power of $a$ annihilates $a^k\ell-a^j\ell'$. Free means isomorphic to $\bigoplus_{i\in I}R_a$ for some set $I$, which need not be finite. No Noetherian hypothesis on $R$ is imposed.
